_about: The anesthetic buff (the owner, 2026-10-27: "15% pain and duration for 15 seconds"; srp-026g/docs/notes/booster-buffs.md). The Anesthetic (painkiller, a drug used from a pocket) has one effect, data/damage_protection[0]: on the pain pool, for ranged hits, threshold 0, a hit's pain x hit_coeff x max(0, 1 + modifier 58) (medkit::reduce_damage 0x33DB30). It is on from the press for activation_delay_sec (1 s, which holds back only influences, and it has none) + activity_time_sec x max(0, 1 + modifier 34) (set_active 0x33D390, tick 0x33D790; Unicorn: client-patches/check_anesthetic_026g.py). Its card's "Pain threshold: 10%" (line 17) is 1 - 0.9. The value is changed in its own direction: hit_coeff 0.9 -> 0.85 (bullets' pain -15 %, "Pain threshold: 15%"), activity_time_sec 10 -> 15 (an int, kept; "Duration: 15.0s", line 18): x0.85 for 16 s from the press, was x0.9 for 11 s. Not the other reading, pain at 15 % (hit_coeff 0.15, -85 %). The description names no number; activation 1 s and weight unchanged.
